t: Mi sheyyashab lo badderek lanuach velo yada im hu battechum im lav
s: Mi sheyyashab lo badderek lanuach velo yada im hu battechum im lav ubo seip echad: mi shehaya ba badderek likkanes lair veyashab badderek lanuach vechoshka lo, velo yada shehu bitchum hair, veachar kak matza atzmo bitchuma — qana shebita bair veniknas letokah beshabbat, umehallek et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lekol ruach. Veap al pi shennitkavven liqnot shebita bimqomo, kevan sheillu haya yodea shehair betok techumo lo haya chapetz liqnot shebita ella im bene hair — hare hu keillu qana shebita immahem. Abal im lo haya bedato kelal likkanes leir zo, qana shebita bimqomo, umishsham yesh lo alpayim amma lekol ruach. Veim kalim alpayim mimmeqom shebitato bachatzi hair, eno mehallek bair yoter mechetzyah. Veim kalim besop hair, kol hair nechshebet lo ked' ammot, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"ch. Vaapillu im mibbeod yom haya bedato likkanes leir zo, uben hashshemashot amar beperush "shebitati bimqomi" — hare aqar shebitato meanshe hair veqana shebita bimqomo:
